name: Lumentum Holdings

eyebrow.en: Lumentum Holdings Inc. · Common stock · San Jose, California
eyebrow.zh: Lumentum · 普通股 · 加州圣何塞

title.zh: AI 光互连里的激光器。

lede.en: Lumentum makes the lasers, transceivers and optical circuit switches that link GPUs inside AI data centers. Revenue doubled to $1.0B last quarter and is guided to $1.25B, with non-GAAP operating margin heading to 40%. The stock is up about seven-fold in a year.
lede.zh: Lumentum 生产连接 AI 数据中心内 GPU 的激光器、光模块和光路交换机。上季营收翻倍至 10 亿美元，本季指引 12.5 亿，非GAAP营业利润率迈向 40%。股价一年上涨约七倍。

s.en: Q1 FY27 · date not yet announced
s.zh: FY27 第一季 · 日期未公布

sub_price.en: Daily closes with the 50-day average. Lumentum rose about seven-fold over the year on AI optical demand.
sub_price.zh: 每日收盘价与50日均线。受 AI 光通信需求带动，股价一年上涨约七倍。

sub_rev.en: Revenue in US$ millions, with GAAP gross margin on the right axis. Lumentum's fiscal year ends around July 1. Q4 FY26 GAAP EPS of −$84.65 comes from a one-time $7.8B non-cash charge for converting notes into stock. The last bar is guidance at the midpoint.
sub_rev.zh: 营收单位为百万美元，右轴为 GAAP 毛利率。Lumentum 财年约在7月1日结束。FY26 第四季 GAAP 每股 −$84.65 源于可转债转股的一次性 78 亿美元非现金费用。最后一根柱为指引中值。

s.zh: 同比 +109% · 连续第8季增长

p.en: Record 800G transceiver shipments and the first 1.6T production shipments in Q4. Management expects 1.6T adoption to intensify through calendar 2027.
p.zh: 第四季 800G 光模块出货创纪录，1.6T 开始量产出货。管理层预计 1.6T 在 2027 年加速普及。

p.en: OCS shipments are expanding at hyperscalers, and near-packaged optics and ultra-high-power lasers come next, with a $100M+ laser quarter targeted for Q3 FY27.
p.zh: OCS 在云厂商的出货持续扩大，近封装光学与超高功率激光器紧随其后，目标在 FY27 第三季实现单季逾 1 亿美元激光器收入。

p.en: Management says supply, not demand, is the binding constraint. Capex rose to $167M in Q4 to add capacity.
p.zh: 管理层表示制约因素是供给而非需求。第四季资本开支升至 1.67 亿美元以扩产。

p.en: Converting $1.1B of notes cut debt by 35% but issued new shares and created the $7.8B GAAP charge. About $2B of convertible debt remains.
p.zh: 转换 11 亿美元可转债使债务减少 35%，但增发新股并产生 78 亿美元 GAAP 费用。仍有约 20 亿美元可转债。

p.en: Growth depends on a handful of hyperscalers' AI build-outs. A pause in their orders would show up quickly.
p.zh: 增长依赖少数云厂商的 AI 建设，一旦订单暂停会很快反映。

p.en: About 66× annualized guided earnings after a seven-fold rise. Optical stocks swing hard on AI capex headlines, so position sizing matters.
p.zh: 股价上涨七倍后，约为年化指引盈利的 66 倍。光通信股随 AI 资本开支新闻剧烈波动，仓位控制很重要。

p.en: Guide: $1.225–1.275B revenue, 39.5–40.5% non-GAAP operating margin, EPS $4.05–4.35. Last year's Q1 was reported on Nov 4.
p.zh: 指引：营收 12.25–12.75 亿美元，非GAAP营业利润率 39.5–40.5%，每股 $4.05–4.35。去年第一季于11月4日发布。

p.en: 1.6T transceiver uptake is expected to build through the year.
p.zh: 预计 1.6T 光模块需求全年持续增长。

p.en: Target: first $100M+ quarter for ultra-high-power lasers.
p.zh: 目标：超高功率激光器首个单季逾 1 亿美元收入。

Q4 FY26 call summary and targets

foot.en: Fundamentals as of Oct 9, 2026. For information only, not investment advice. Not affiliated with Lumentum Holdings Inc..
foot.zh: 基本面数据截至 2026年10月9日。仅供参考，不构成投资建议。与 Lumentum Holdings Inc. 无关联。

sub.en: Free cash flow is operating cash flow minus capital spending, in US$ millions, for the 20 quarters from Q1 FY22 to Q4 FY26. Lumentum's fiscal year ends around July 1. Shaded bars and italic rows are estimates.
sub.zh: 自由现金流 = 经营现金流 − 资本开支，单位百万美元，涵盖 FY22 第一季至 FY26 第四季共 20 个季度。Lumentum 财年约在7月1日结束。浅色柱与斜体行为估算。

s.zh: 2026年6月 · 剩余可转债约 20 亿

read.en: Lumentum spent most of 2023 to 2025 near break-even on cash as telecom demand slumped and it invested in cloud products. AI optics turned it around: free cash flow went from −$18M in Q1 FY26 to +$196M in Q4 FY26, even as capex more than doubled.
read.zh: 2023 至 2025 年电信需求低迷、公司投入云产品，Lumentum 现金流大多在盈亏平衡附近。AI 光通信扭转局面：自由现金流由 FY26 第一季的 −1800 万美元升至第四季的 +1.96 亿，同期资本开支翻倍有余。

read.en: Using Q1 FY27 guidance ($1.25B revenue at about 40% operating margin) and capex of about $180–210M a quarter, I estimate $240–350M of free cash flow a quarter, roughly $1.2B over four quarters. Cash fell $430M in Q4 because of the note conversion, not because of operations.
read.zh: 按 FY27 第一季指引（营收 12.5 亿美元、营业利润率约 40%）及每季约 1.8–2.1 亿美元资本开支，我估计每季自由现金流 2.4–3.5 亿美元，四季合计约 12 亿。第四季现金减少 4.3 亿是因可转债转换，而非经营所致。

p.en: Capex was $167M in Q4 and rising, for laser and transceiver lines serving cloud and AI customers.
p.zh: 第四季资本开支 1.67 亿美元且在上升，用于服务云和 AI 客户的激光器与光模块产线。

p.en: About $2B of convertible debt remains; $524M of debt was repaid in Q4 as part of the conversion.
p.zh: 仍有约 20 亿美元可转债；第四季因转换偿还债务 5.24 亿美元。

p.en: $117M of stock repurchases in Q4, up from $5M a year earlier.
p.zh: 第四季回购 1.17 亿美元股票，一年前为 500 万。

p.en: Q1 FY27 is guided to about $1.25B of revenue, more than 130% above a year ago.
p.zh: FY27 第一季营收指引约 12.5 亿美元，同比增逾 130%。

p.en: Non-GAAP operating margin is guided to 39.5–40.5%, up from 36.6%, as factories run fuller.
p.zh: 随产能利用率提高，非GAAP营业利润率指引 39.5–40.5%，高于 36.6%。

bridgeNote.en: Excludes further note conversions, debt repayment and buybacks.
bridgeNote.zh: 未计入后续可转债转换、偿债及回购。
